newsitem.title: USA: Riviera Tool in new lending arrangement.
newsitem.headline: Riviera Tool in new lending arrangement.

text.p: Riviera Tool Co, an automotive industry stamping die systems maker, said Monday it entered a new principle lending relationship subsequent to the end of the fiscal 1997 third quarter ended May 31.

The new arrangement reduces the company's cost of capital by 750 basis points while also providing a facility to finance it's strategic investments in integrated technology and capital equipment, Riviera said.

These investments will result in substantial continuous improvement in cost, quality and reduced product development time which should materially enhance earnings and long term shareholder value, the company said in a news release.
The company also said that after the end of the third quarter it was awarded a $3.1 million new order from the Saturn Division of General Motors Corp.
Earlier Monday, the company reported net income of $244,053 or $0.14 a share for the third quarter, compared to $71,888 or $0.05 a share a year ago.
Riviera Tools shares were up 3/8 to 5-1/2.
